body.x: ETAS Korea (CEO Indeuk Hwang), the Korean subsidiary of ETAS, participated in the 2024 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2024), held from October 23 to 26 at Daegu EXCO. ETAS is a subsidiary of Bosch, renowned for its expertise in automotive and industrial technologies, specializing in Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) solutions, including basic software, middleware, development tools, and cloud-based services.
ETAS Korea supplies advanced solutions to domestic automakers and suppliers, enhancing the efficiency, operation, and security of automotive software development.

At FIX 2024, ETAS Korea showcased its portfolio of SDV-related solutions. The company provides various virtualization and automation technologies to maximize software development efficiency. Their offerings include cloud-based toolchains and parallel pipeline-enabled virtual testing environments that significantly accelerate customer development processes.

Additionally, ETAS Korea provides standardized and interoperable solutions that offer developers flexible integration with first- and third-party tools. Their solutions span the entire SDV business model, from vehicles to the cloud, with robust security offerings.

ETAS also excels in developing high-performance real-time application environments for basic software, middleware, and configuration tools based on global standards. Their AUTOSAR-based middleware solutions are a reliable backbone for smooth and stable software integration in the mobility market.

A representative from ETAS Korea stated, “We provide high-performance hardware and software capable of collecting, analyzing, and processing all types of vehicle data, including ECU, internal networks, buses, and sensors, without any data loss. Leveraging our extensive experience and expertise, we also offer consulting and engineering services to help customers implement SDV systems and achieve DevOps cycle integration, earning strong recognition for our capabilities.”

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
